annotations.text:
THE LIBRARY - realm 4 of THE AUDHDITIES CONDUCTING PLAN, step P.

Eight boards, drawn under KP's build law - FRAMEWORK FIRST - read as he named it for this realm: "athena with contents". Here the contents ARE the frame. A hall is only a door until you can say what stands behind it, so every board draws the shelves as they truly are, machine-counted from the seed that filled them: 6 quests - 1 course and 6 lessons - 1 telling - 10 sigils - 30 stars in 5 collections. This is the one realm on the plan whose rooms are already full.

Top row: 1 the hub, the six halls as doors with an honest inventory on each - 2 the Path, where a button that starts nothing is retired and the quest's own doors become the beginning - 3 the Floating Stars, the realm's heavy room, with the four built caps spoken in words and every bar and ratio gone by KP's ruling - 4 Courses and Lessons, where a place is kept without a percentage and the toggle that keeps it is drawn off. Bottom row: 5 the Archive, redrawn at KP's word this sitting as a shelf of the real mythologies the house takes its names from - 6 the Honors, earned only, with the unearned drawn as nothing at all - 7 the Dailies, drawn empty on 2026-08-24 because that session was KP's own, and redrawn whole on 2026-08-25 at his word once he had built the hall and run docs/sql/022: the seventh hall as it stands, from the code, beside frames for the three forms of his roster still to come - 8 the ways between, fifteen routes and every empty state in the realm read whole.

Every board carries the ten-point sensory checklist on its right rail, the opt-in law, a refusal column, and KP's own ruling verbatim where a board embodies one. A gold dot means proposed - drawn plainest where the ground is silent, never landed as though it were ruled. Every copy rewrite is marked old to new with the file and line it came from; six rewrites out of 1,739 lines, because this realm writes well.

Colours are cosmic tokens only, the library triad over deepSpace at the ambient 0.3. Every contrast figure is measured, not estimated: the method reproduces HANDOFF.md's own 14.4:1 and 12.3:1 exactly. The figure worth reading twice is on board 5 - the provenance line, the one place in the app that renders a citation for a reader, sits at 2.69:1.

Nothing in src/ was edited to draw this.

DECLINED - three alternatives drawn and set down, each with the ground that declined it.

Kept on the canvas rather than deleted, because a design without its refusals is a claim with no reason attached. All three are the tempting middle ways: the honest inventory turned into a score, the ruled-away catalog redrawn as silhouettes, and the ruled-away bar bent into a circle. Two of the three were closed by a ruling KP made the same day, and the third by a refusal E4's column names outright.

Each board also records what was kept from the idea after the idea was refused - which in all three cases is the worry underneath it, answered somewhere better.
